notes.title: Early Access Problems
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone. We are unable to release Barely Working as early access on Steam due to them no longer supporting early access for adult games.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44180796/d2a876f1a2562d694ed233e7788d5226ef2175c1.png"][/img][/p][p]We will be releasing Barely Working on Steam when it is fully complete. As of today, here are the levels that are complete and the ones that are incomplete:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44180796/68230596118cf21151f779ade392e22753899793.png"][/img][/p][p]I'm sorry for not being able to fulfil the promise, I'm afraid this is out of my control. We look forward to bringing a complete package to Steam once we are done with development.[/p]
